title: Fixed Two-Axis Survey Transit
description: One complete newly authored static survey-transit visual. Three splayed tripod legs and finite feet support a three-screw tribrach, stacked azimuth plates, two vertical fork arms, a horizontal trunnion and a single short longitudinal telescope with genuinely recessed objective and ocular mouths. A separate vertical circle and blank level case complete the fixed instrument. Not an old equatorial mount reposed, not a widened twin-end rangefinder or flat vane alidade. One complete model, zero scenes. Opaque solid PBR only; no optical path, surveying accuracy, graduation, calibration, axis movement, levelling function, load, stability, manufacture or safety claim.
